call_binding.binding: Bind positions, then exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: No evaluated/mutable defaults, unpostponed annotations, type parameters, used variadics, extra arguments, unpacking, async/generator calls, external-rule keywords or non-normalized names.
call_binding.defaults: Omitted slots use source-free immutable scalars; explicit arguments override defaults. Definition-time effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.definitions: Module function bodies defer with literal or known prior defaults, including variadics. Calls accept literals or captured local scalars. Annotations: checked module-local future, <=128 nodes, no await/yield/assignment/type unpacking.
call_binding.evaluation: Evaluate explicit values once in source order before binding.
call_binding.initialization: Inert: literals/aliases, builtin refs/maps, exports, plain instances, prior function __doc__. Bases: none/unshadowed object/dict/Exception. Lambda/dict setup/item/update <=128 nodes; own writes only.
call_binding.invalid: Missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments leave analysis incomplete; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only slots; required or immutable scalar defaults.
call_binding.variadics: Omit unused ASCII variadics whose names never occur in the body. Calls bind fixed slots; annotations follow definition rules.
